why: Must_not 2 is broken. Check 3 passes only if each exported function has a Markdown heading matching `^#+ .*\bname\s*\(`. Line 3 just asks that README.md "documents every function", so a README covering `subtract` in a bullet or in prose would fail. That makes a specific README layout a requirement, and the demand for "a section with a description" adds more layout. Check 4 also requires the TAP summary `# fail 0`, which may not appear in that form depending on Node's default reporter. Must_not 1 is avoided: Check 3 loops over every export, so it fails when `subtract` is undocumented. Checks 1 and 2 test values and the RangeError type only, not exact messages or parameter counts.
